title: Tongyi Qianwen Open Platform Launches, Conversational-as-a-Service Enables Full-Chain Integration in Daily Life Scenarios

content_html:
The Tongyi Qianwen Open Platform was officially launched recently, offering developers access to services on mobile, PC, and AI glasses. Users no longer need to switch apps; they can complete various daily service operations within the conversation.

The platform currently covers more than ten fields, including logistics, rental housing, home services, and financial management. Users can check packages and send them by @SF Express, match properties by @ZiRu Rent based on location and budget, and view them virtually. They can also book cleaning services and verify contracts via @Tian’e Home, while @Yingmi Fund's Qiu Gu will provide financial analysis based on risk preferences. Additionally, @Caiyun Weather can recommend suitable times for walking dogs, @Shansong allows changing delivery addresses within the conversation, and @Mei Di can monitor water quality at home and identify appliance malfunctions. All these services are completed within the conversation, forming a closed loop.

content_html_zh:
统一钱文开放平台于近日正式上线，为开发者提供移动端、PC端、AI眼镜端的服务。 用户不再需要切换应用程序；他们可以在对话中完成各种日常服务操作。

该平台目前涵盖物流、租赁住房、家居服务、财务管理等十多个领域。 用户可以查看包裹并通过@顺丰速运发送，通过@ZiRu Rent根据位置和预算匹配房产，并进行虚拟查看。 他们还可以通过@天鹅之家预订清洁服务并验证合同，而@英米基金的秋谷将根据风险偏好提供财务分析。 此外，@彩云天气可以推荐适合遛狗的时间，@山松可以在对话中更改送货地址，@美迪可以监控家里的水质并识别电器故障。 所有这些服务都是在会话内完成的，形成一个闭环。
